statusSummary: Prerequisite scan complete: Container Apps is feasible, but AWS SDK migration and one A2A startup fix block deployment.

intent.userPrompt: I am planning on deploying this project as an Azure service, ideally as a Container App if possible.
intent.description: Assess this repository and identify a feasible Azure deployment architecture, prioritizing Azure Container Apps.
scanDiscoveredFacts: The repository is a Python 3.14, React/Vite, and TypeScript monorepo with Docker, Docker Compose, Helm, and GitHub Actions deployment surfaces.
The registry, auth server, metrics service, MCP servers, and A2A agents have container definitions that can map to Azure Container Apps.
The registry image combines nginx and uvicorn and exposes 8080, 8443, and 7860; Container Apps should use one ingress port and keep the raw API port internal.
MongoDB is the primary durable application store; Docker Compose also includes Keycloak, OpenBao, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, Grafana, and optional PingFederate.
Metrics and both A2A agents use SQLite or local filesystem state that is ephemeral or single-replica constrained on Container Apps.
Functional AWS dependencies remain in optional or default-enabled paths for Cognito, DocumentDB IAM, Secrets Manager, Bedrock embeddings, AgentCore, the CLI, and Strands-based A2A agents.
No Azure-specific azure.yaml, Bicep, or Terraform configuration was found; Azure infrastructure would be greenfield.

cloudSdkFindings.azureEquivalent: MongoDB Atlas or Cosmos DB for MongoDB, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Container Apps managed identity
cloudSdkFindings.requiredAction: Swap or explicitly disable DocumentDB IAM, Cognito, Secrets Manager, and AgentCore paths before Azure deployment.

cloudSdkFindings.dependency: langchain-aws and Bedrock LiteLLM model paths
cloudSdkFindings.azureEquivalent: Azure OpenAI or another OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint configured through LiteLLM
cloudSdkFindings.requiredAction: Use a non-Bedrock embedding provider and remove or disable AWS credential-dependent model configuration.

cloudSdkFindings.azureEquivalent: Microsoft Entra ID or Entra External ID
cloudSdkFindings.requiredAction: Select and configure Entra ID or retain a separately hosted production IdP; do not leave the Cognito default path enabled.

cloudSdkFindings.azureEquivalent: Azure OpenAI or another supported model API
cloudSdkFindings.requiredAction: Replace the Bedrock CLI model client or exclude the optional Bedrock command from the Azure release.

cloudSdkFindings.azureEquivalent: Azure OpenAI-compatible agent implementation hosted in Container Apps
cloudSdkFindings.requiredAction: Replace or adapt the AWS-oriented model/runtime integration, or disable the A2A images for the first Azure deployment.

overrides.reason: User explicitly prefers Container Apps when feasible.
